lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly equidistant horizontal rows and vertical columns across the central lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating focal anchor nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal linear features running horizontally along the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge to low-intensity shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 5-7 high-luminance blobs located within the visible boundaries of the first dorsal fin's leading edge and surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-frequency cluster of smaller, high-luminance spots localized in the cephalic region, transitioning to a lower-frequency, larger-diameter spot distribution on the posterior flank.
